findings.text: bats_execute now sets PATH from BATS_SAVED_PATH, but the patch doesn't define that variable and nothing else in the directory references it (I only had the patch to search). If it is unset in any caller's scope, PATH becomes empty and every command run through bats_execute fails with 'command not found'. The original BATS_PATH is no longer used.
